text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...! Dammit,
I already decided to quit, didn't I...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "...Tch, that fool, doing whatever they please...!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the moment is upon us.
A fierce battle amidst falling cherry blossoms, the Tenno Sho (Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The Umamusume drawing the most eyes is naturally Orfevre.
Followed closely by Win Variation, perhaps—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...
Alright, I'm heading out.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Hehe, I'm not kidding!
I'm feeling in great shape.
Like I can pour everything I've worked for into this!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Please watch over me,
Trainer!

—After that incident at the Fan Appreciation Festival,
she went to apologize to Win Variation once more.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
P-Please lift your head...!
Trainer, you really did nothing wrong!
choice_data_list: No, I'm really sorry I didn't notice anything
No, I'm truly sorry for not noticing anything.

text_block_list.text: When she expressed such deep gratitude to me at summer camp, it made me wonder if I should have done more.
Even though I thought that, seeing her rely on me strictly as a Trainer led me to jump to conclusions—

Fearing that unwanted prying might cause
more stress, they had avoided bringing up
any worries she hadn't shared herself.

It was completely my error in judgment.
Because of that, Win Variation's racing career was nearly cut short.

From now on, I want us to
proceed while properly talking things through.

So if there is anything at all that you
feel like talking about, please don't hesitate
to share it with me—

"So if there's anything you'd like to share,
even the slightest thing,
please don't hesitate to speak to me—"
I told her that whenever something is too heavy to carry alone, we should share the burden and resolve it together as a pair.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I...
I didn't understand.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Just how much resolve Trainer had
when signing that contract with me that day.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (...Trainer has always been watching over me. Even on New Year's and Valentine's Day, they silently tried to take my mind off things...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(......"Trainer is trying so hard, so I can't say I can't do it"—
Thinking like that is just selfish...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
From now on... I'll make sure to say it.
Whenever I feel weak, as much as I can.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I-I might end up getting on your nerves
sometimes, but...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Still, we have to walk together.
My dream is your dream... after all, right?

Training went smoothly after that.
Win Variation regained her focus—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...!
Not yet, it starts from here...!
choice_data_list: Good, keep it just like that!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, yes!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: U-Um, well... I was watching footage of Orfe-san's past races, and...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...I got so nervous I couldn't sleep...
I'm so sorry... for not getting enough rest.
choice_data_list: Then why don't we watch it together one more time?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
choice_data_list: Let's both watch and put together a solid plan.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Thank you very much!
I'm in your care!

Even when hesitating, she began to share her anxieties with me.
After spending our days together like that—the day of the Tenno Sho (Spring) arrived!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (...Strange.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...Just knowing someone understands me
makes my heart feel so light.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: —Hm?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(T-That startled me...
Even though it was Orfe-san, I didn't notice...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Come to think of it... they seemed in a bad mood, didn't they?
I wonder what's wrong...?)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, now's not the time for that...!
Focus, focus!
